tasks.short: Produce and release course catalogs and class schedules.

steps.what: Collect course facts for university publications.
Lay out course catalogs and class schedules in the catalog.
Reconcile catalog text with the course and schedule facts.

loop.input: Catalog sentences and the fact pack from the course record
loop.output: A mark on each sentence: matches, conflicts, or has no source
loop.check: Administrator resolves every conflict before the draft moves on
loop.stop: One pass. An unsourced sentence is deleted, not guessed.
loop.why_not_simpler: Catalog prose drifts from fields, so a template cannot see the drift

steps.what: Ask faculty to clear the pages of the publications.
Approve the university publications version for release.
Handle dissemination of catalogs and class schedules.

tasks.design: Course facts come from {LMS} into {CMS}. Catalog text is reconciled to those facts, faculty clear the pages, and the administrator approves the version. Dissemination from {CMS} uses that version only.
tasks.previous_blocker: Catalogs were pasted from last year, and a time in the schedule no longer matched the course record.
tasks.enabler_now: The course record is structured, and a page can be checked sentence by sentence against it.
tasks.still_hard: Faculty clearance, and the call when a sentence and a fact disagree.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator approves what the university publishes. A layout is not that approval.

ambition.what: A mid-year schedule sheet for courses that start outside the main term

tasks.altitude: Clearance and approval stay. Facts are no longer retyped. A mid-year sheet can use the same checked facts.

reach.task: Publish a school prospectus and a class timetable
reach.learn: Which lines must match a system of record before the document goes out

evidence.claim: A person has to check catalog facts. A draft can state a time or a credit that the source record does not hold.
Dissemination of a university publication is an external release and follows the version a person approved.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: production and dissemination of course catalogs and class schedules for one edition. Marketing campaigns are out of scope.
Structured fields: course id, credit, class time, room, sentence id, match status. The course office owns the source record. A sentence with no source is deleted.
Use the catalog tool and the learning system already installed before a custom publisher.
If faculty have not cleared a page, that page is not in the approved version.
unknowns: Which publications the administrator must approve in person.
How a change after dissemination is corrected.
Whether class schedules and catalogs share one version or two.
research_questions: Is the catalog generated from the course record today, or maintained as a separate document?

incremental.description: Refresh catalog source facts when a course or a class time changes

approvals.approved_version: catalog and schedule version the administrator approved after faculty clearance
dissemination of that approved catalogs and schedules version

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: many sentences conflict and faculty clearance is slow. High: the record is clean and approval is a short read. Clearance and approval stay. Not a measured saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write grants for external funding and supervise the projects.

steps.what: Read the call and mark rules for external funding.

loop.output: Rules, dates and required sections, each tied to a line of the call
loop.check: Administrator deletes a rule that the call does not state
loop.stop: One pass. Ambiguous wording is marked unknown.
loop.why_not_simpler: Calls are long prose, not a fixed form

steps.what: Draft the grants narrative from the source pack only.

loop.input: The rule list and the source pack of citations and figures
loop.output: Narrative sentences that each point at a source-pack item
loop.check: Any citation or number absent from the source pack is deleted
loop.stop: One draft, then one retry. A gap is left for the administrator to write.
loop.why_not_simpler: The case for funding is prose, and a merge of last year's text invents citations

steps.what: Build the grant budget from listed project costs.
Decide the grants pack is ready to submit.
Submit the grants pack through the funder portal.
Supervise grant-funded projects against the spend plan.

tasks.design: The call is read into a rule list in {DOCS}. The narrative is drafted only from the source pack, and the budget is summed in {SPREADSHEET} from listed costs. {GOV_PORTAL} receives the pack only after the administrator decides it is ready, and supervision of the live project stays in {PROJECT}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Narratives reused old paragraphs, and a figure in the text did not match the budget.
tasks.enabler_now: A call's required sections can be listed, and a sentence can be kept only when its citation is in the pack.
tasks.still_hard: Judging that the pack is honest, and supervising a live project that drifts.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator decides what is submitted and whether a project is off its plan. A draft is not a submission.

ambition.what: Whether a live grant is off its spend plan, once a month

tasks.altitude: Writing and supervision stay. Citations without a source are gone before the decision. Submission still waits for the administrator.

reach.task: Prepare a bid and then supervise the funded work
reach.learn: Which numbers must trace to a source pack before the file is sent

evidence.claim: A narrative sentence that cites a source or a number not in the pack should be deleted before anyone treats the draft as ready.
Supervising a funded project is a running judgement about people, progress and spend. It is not a report.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: one external funding call, the grants pack, the submission, and supervision of projects that call funded. Scholarship payments are a different task.
Structured fields: call requirement, source-pack item, budget line, cost source, spend to date. The project lead supplies costs. A number with no source is omitted.
Use the document store, the spreadsheet, the project record and the funder portal before a custom bid tool.
If the funder has no portal, the same pack is uploaded or sent by the administrator by hand, still only after the ready decision.
A sponsor signature above the administrator's authority sits outside this task.
unknowns: Which calls the administrator writes rather than a colleague.
The funder's file rules and portal.
Who tells the administrator that spend has moved.
research_questions: Is the source pack a controlled set of documents, or a folder that changes after the draft?

incremental.description: Keep the citation checklist and the live spend extract current

approvals.approved_version: grants pack the administrator decided was ready
submission of that ready grants pack

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the call is unusual and supervision meetings run long. High: the pack is familiar and the narrative is an edit. The ready decision and the supervision stay. Not a measured saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan and promote sporting, social and cultural events.

steps.what: Choose sporting, cultural and recreational activities to host.
Draft the plan and a small budget for the events.

loop.input: The chosen events and the known room and cost figures
loop.output: A plan and a budget that use only those figures
loop.check: Administrator removes any cost that was not supplied
loop.stop: One draft. A missing cost stays blank.
loop.why_not_simpler: Proposals arrive as notes, not a budget form

steps.what: Book rooms and times for the sporting events.
Host the social, cultural or sporting event.
Promote the events on the notice the administrator edits.

loop.input: The event plan and the confirmed booking
loop.output: A notice with time, place and title taken from that plan
loop.check: Administrator edits the notice before it is public
loop.stop: One draft. A detail with no booking is left out.
loop.why_not_simpler: The notice has to match a plan that is still prose

tasks.design: The administrator chooses the events. A plan and a small budget are drafted, rooms are booked on {CALENDAR}, and the event is hosted in person. The notice goes out through {CMS}, {SOCIAL} and {EMAIL} only after the administrator edits it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Events were announced before a room was held, and the notice contradicted the plan.
tasks.enabler_now: A booking can be made from a confirmed time, and a notice can be filled from that booking.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing what to host, and being the host.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator chooses and hosts. A notice does not create the event.

ambition.what: Whether a proposed event clashes with teaching, before it is announced

tasks.altitude: Hosting stays. The choice is made against the teaching calendar. Nothing is public before the notice is edited.

reach.task: Plan a social event for guests and confirm the room first
reach.learn: Which details can be announced only after the booking exists

evidence.claim: Hosting a sporting, social or cultural event is presence. The notice is a later step.
A public notice is a publication and should match the booking a person has confirmed.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: planning, promotion and hosting of one sporting, social, cultural or recreational activity. Course timetables are a different task.
Structured fields: event id, room, start, cost line, notice text. The organiser supplies the cost. A cost with no source is blank.
Use the calendar and the existing notice channels before a custom events tool.
Spend above the administrator's delegated limit is approved outside this task. The notice is not sent until the room is booked.
unknowns: Which events the administrator must host in person.
The delegated limit for an event budget.
Who else may edit a public notice.
research_questions: Does the teaching calendar already show events, or only classes?

incremental.description: Keep the teaching calendar used to see clashes before an event is announced

approvals.approved_version: public notice the administrator edited from the confirmed plan

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: hosting runs long and plans are rewritten on the day. High: the choice is clear and the notice is a short edit. Hosting and the choice stay. Not a measured saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Catalog facts, a grant budget tied to listed costs, and a room booking are ready before the meeting. Faculty clearance, the decision to submit, and hosting the event stay. Catalogs, grant packs and public notices leave only on a version the administrator has approved.
reach: Architectural and engineering managers can reuse a source-pack check on a bid narrative
Lodging managers can see that a notice waits until the room is actually booked
skills_to_grow: Deleting a catalog sentence that the course record does not support
Refusing a grant sentence whose citation is not in the source pack
Announcing an event only after it is checked against teaching
role.ambitious_version: No catalog, grant pack or event notice claims a fact the source record, the source pack or the booking does not hold.
